references.text: For a child is born to us, a son is given to us; and the government shall be upon his shoulder. This verse predicts Jesus' birth and is a reason for great joy, as the angel announces in Luke 2:10.

She will give birth to a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins. This is a direct connection to the message of joy in Luke 2:10, since Jesus' birth brings salvation and thus great joy.
Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those with whom he is pleased! This verse complements Luke 2:10 by expressing the result of the great joy - peace on earth.

Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions. This verse in Hebrews points to Jesus as the source of joy, in line with the message of great joy in Luke 2:10.
